title: ExplorerModulesScreen
responsibility: Discover capability modules and their installation and generation instructions.

inputs.name: ExplorerModulesScreen.index
inputs.description: Not read by this component; it is forwarded to the shared ExplorerFrame inside the host object that this component passes unchanged.

inputs.name: ExplorerModulesScreen.head
inputs.description: Only head.modules is read: when it is set, its modules are filtered to drop entries with visibility 'internal' and builtin entries that are includedByDefault unless testing is set, and its gaps are shown as a notice. When head.modules is unset, the screen shows the message 'No plugin catalog was indexed for this revision.' and never a plugin list or plugin detail.

inputs.name: ExplorerModulesScreen.parent
inputs.description: Not read by this component; it is forwarded to the shared ExplorerFrame inside the host object, and this component never checks it for null.

inputs.name: ExplorerModulesScreen.scope
inputs.description: Not read by this component; it is forwarded to the shared ExplorerFrame inside the host object that this component passes unchanged.

inputs.name: ExplorerModulesScreen.route
inputs.description: Its entity field selects the view: when it is unset or empty the Plugins list renders, and when it is set the plugin whose definition.id equals it renders, or 'Plugin not found' when no plugin in the filtered catalog has that id. Its branch and commit are copied into the breadcrumb and plugin links that this component builds, and for installed plugins the whole route is passed to moduleResourceLocation to build resource links.

inputs.name: ExplorerModulesScreen.entities
inputs.description: Not read by this component; it is forwarded to the shared ExplorerFrame inside the host object that this component passes unchanged.

inputs.name: ExplorerModulesScreen.lens
inputs.description: Only lens.href is used: the link snippet calls it with each ExplorerLocation while rendering, and its return value becomes that link's href. An error thrown by href is not caught in this component, so it propagates out of rendering.

inputs.name: ExplorerModulesScreen.client
inputs.description: Not read by this component; it is forwarded to the shared ExplorerFrame inside the host object that this component passes unchanged.

inputs.name: ExplorerModulesScreen.mediaBase
inputs.description: A string field of host that this component never reads; it reaches the shared ExplorerFrame inside the host object that this component passes unchanged.

inputs.name: ExplorerModulesScreen.onroute
inputs.description: Called with the target ExplorerLocation of a link in this screen only when plainClick accepts the click, and after this component has called preventDefault on the event.

outputs.name: catalog
outputs.description: The markup this component renders inside the shared ExplorerFrame. With no route.entity it shows the Plugins heading and the plugin list (with a notice listing head.modules gaps when there are any), or an empty-state message when there is no catalog or no plugins; with route.entity it shows a breadcrumb and that plugin's detail, or a 'Plugin not found' heading with an empty-state message.

errors.name: lens.href callback error
errors.description: An error thrown by host.lens.href is not caught in this component, so it propagates out of rendering the links that call it: the plugin titles in the list, the Plugins breadcrumb in a plugin view, and the resource titles of installed plugins.

errors.name: onroute callback error
errors.description: An error thrown by host.onroute is not caught in this component, so it propagates out of the link's click handler after this component has already called preventDefault on the event.

errors.name: each_key_duplicate
errors.description: Two plugins with the same definition.id, or two resources in one plugin with the same id, give a keyed each block duplicate keys, which Svelte reports as an each_key_duplicate error while that block mounts or updates.
